title: Jobsy Upgradeable Tools
description: A New Custom Plugin Adding Upgradeable Minecraft Pickaxe
body:
**# # Jobsy Tools v2.0.0

The first public release of Jobsy Pickaxe for Paper 1.21x!

## Features

# ⛏ Custom Jobsy Tools

* Added the Jobsy Pickaxe custom item.
* Persistent upgrade system.
* Custom lore displaying pickaxe progression.
* Secure item identification system.

### 📈 Progression System

* Pickaxe levels.
* Pickaxe XP.
* Upgradeable mining abilities.
* Long-term player progression.

### 💎 Shard Economy

* Earn Playtime Shards while mining.
* Use shards to purchase upgrades.
* Configurable shard rewards.

### 🖥 Upgrade GUI

* Shift + Right Click to open the upgrade menu.
* Modern GUI layout.
* Upgrade cost display.
* Level progression tracking.

### ⚡ Upgrades

* Haste upgrades.
* Fortune upgrades.
* Token Finder upgrades.
* Auto Sell upgrades.
* Magnet upgrades.
* Experience Boost upgrades.
* Lucky Rewards upgrades.

### 💾 Data Storage

* SQLite database support.
* Automatic player data saving.
* Persistent progression across restarts.

### ⚙ Configuration

* Fully configurable upgrade costs.
* Customizable GUI titles.
* Configurable messages and sounds.
* Adjustable shard rewards.

### 🔒 Security

* PersistentDataContainer item identification.
* Protection against fake renamed items.
* Upgrade validation checks.
* SMP-ready design.

## Commands

* `/jobsypickaxe give <player>`
* `/jobsypickaxe reload`
* `/jobsypickaxe reset <player>`

## Permissions

* `jobsypickaxe.give`
* `jobsypickaxe.reload`
* `jobsypickaxe.reset`

## Compatibility

* Paper 1.21x
* Java 21
* PlaceholderAPI support (optional)

## Notes

This is the first release of Jobsy Pickaxe. Future updates will include additional tools, new upgrades, balancing improvements, and expanded progression features.**
